Two bugs in harvester: (1) normaliseOutcome mapped MCE 'stalemate' to 'stalemated-loses' without resolving to concrete winner, while plugin returned 'white'/'black' directly. Fixed by resolving stalemate through stalemateMeaning + g.turn to determine who wins. (2) Harvester called checkWin() after turn advance, causing premature stalemate detection from wrong perspective. Fixed by using applyMove() return value instead.
MCE detects insufficient material draw (e.g. K vs K). Plugin does not implement material-based draw detection. Low priority: does not affect playability, only game-end detection in extreme endgames.

implB.name: chess-plugin
implB.outcome: draw (noCheck treats all no-moves as stalemate)

note: Plugin uses noCheck:true to handle the grid-crossing constraint on attacks. Side effect: when opponent has no legal grid-crossing moves AND is in grid-check, MCE reports checkmate but the plugin reports draw/stalemate. Needs a custom checkWin or grid-aware check detection to distinguish the two cases.
